people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Elasah
people.line: Messenger who carried Jeremiah's letter to the exiles

people.name: Gemariah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah; messenger sent by Zedekiah to Nebuchadnezzar.

people.name: Hilkiah
people.line: The high priest who discovered the Book of the Law.

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

people.name: Shaphan
people.line: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:
translations.bsb: The letter was entrusted to Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It stated:
translations.kjv: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
